stop_all_mrp_processes: run the mrp down command to stop all running MRP processes in the system
stop_specific_mrp_processes: run mrp down with process names as arguments to stop only those specific MRP processes
stop_local_mrp_processes: run mrp down with the --local flag to stop only processes defined in the local msetup.py file
stop_processes_without_waiting: run mrp down with the --nowait flag to send stop signals without waiting for processes to finish shutting down
use_life_cycle_set_ask: use the mrp life_cycle set_ask function to signal a process to go down by setting its ask to Ask.DOWN
